referenceBest.policy: Moves and cube decisions: XG Roller+

method: Fixed controlled ablation on opening 21 and the 14 replies classified persistent by the prior independent confirmation. 1024 fresh trials per move/policy in 32 independent batches of 32. Four policies isolate removing the five-turn cutoff, strengthening late checker play, and strengthening cube decisions. Candidate pairs and all policies share dice; seed-disjoint from previous experiments and timing/parity checks. No optional stopping. Full-strong additionally evaluates every previously retained candidate for coherent potential book updates. Three primary paired differences of move gaps per position (45 contrasts) use Bonferroni simultaneous 95% Student-t intervals. Four policy gaps per position form a separate 60-contrast family. Cubeful, Jacoby on, beavers off, normal filters, variance reduction, no rotation, bearoff database termination enabled. This measures continuation-policy and cutoff effects; it does not isolate neural weights from policy or establish XG as exact truth.
